fusions.name: Mauled Where It Lies
fusions.desc: A mauling weapon strike that deals 28 damage plus 6% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Snagging Drag
fusions.desc: Drags a snagged log through a cone 2.5 tiles long that deals 4 damage to every enemy in it, with a 25% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Iron Maw
fusions.desc: Sets a heavy iron jaw at the nearest enemy that arms after 1 second and waits up to 30 seconds. It deals 26 damage to the first enemy to come within 2 tiles and leaves it [Pinned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Poked Once Too Often
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (272% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
